## What this is not

No operating system. No memory protection and no privilege levels. Not a
general-purpose processor — the instruction set in `043` is what a matrix engine
needs to be fed and nothing more. No training beyond low-rank adaptation
(`076a`). Capacity is unremarkable next to the bandwidth; the bandwidth is the
point. **No field-serviceable parts**: service means replacing the cube (`019`).
